ai/npc/KetraOrcSupport/31373-friend.html.text: Grocer Atan: Come on in, comrade of Ketra! I'm responsible for providing supplies to the honorable warriors of our tribe. Under special orders from the chief of our tribe, I can now offer supplies to outsiders like you!

ai/npc/KetraOrcSupport/31373-no.html.text: Grocer Atan: I can't sell supplies to someone who is not a comrade of Ketra! Go away!
